We are preparing The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere for public release.

This is a controlled release-quality pass, NOT a redesign or a new game build.


NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES


1. Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic and two endings.
2. Do not simplify or replace working systems.
3. Do not modify the main branch.
4. Create a separate QA branch based on the latest successfully deployed game.
5. Commit changes on that branch only.
6. Do not rewrite Git history, delete checkpoints, or modify OMGithub session metadata.
7. Do not introduce unnecessary libraries, dependencies or external services.
8. If an existing feature works, preserve it.


TASK 1 — FIX MOBILE CLUE BOARD LAYOUT


Inspect "js/game.js" and "css/style.css".


The clue board uses normalized card positions and currently has fixed mobile card dimensions. Cards can crowd one another on narrow screens.


Implement a responsive layout that:


- Prevents card overlap on small phones.
- Keeps every clue card readable.
- Preserves card selection and dragging.
- Keeps SVG connection lines aligned with their cards.
- Preserves card positions across saving, reloading and viewport changes.
- Does not compromise the desktop experience.


Do not simply shrink every element until the text becomes unreadable.


TASK 2 — FIX SAVE RELIABILITY


Inspect "js/core.js" and "js/game.js".


"SAVE.write()" returns a success/failure result, but "saveNow()" currently ignores it.

## Objective
- Complete a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere,” preserving the existing game and reporting verified results before release.
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns, simplifications, and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run full story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created branch `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Updated `js/game.js` to report save failures, retain the previous save timestamp on failure, and clear the failure indicator after a successful save.
- Updated clue-card rendering and dragging to keep cards within the visible board bounds and queue saves for adjusted positions.
- Updated save-indicator styling in `css/style.css`.
- Ran `git diff --check` and `node --check` on `js/game.js` and `js/core.js`; opened the local game in Playwright.

### Active
- Validate save success/failure behavior and clue-board layout across viewports; run the full story/endings, features, screenshot, and performance regression matrix.
- Inspect screenshots and console output, then commit changes and report results, remaining issues, and physical-device testing needs.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing at representative desktop and mobile sizes; verify clue cards stay in bounds and save failures are displayed truthfully.
2. Run the full gameplay, endings, feature, screenshot, and performance regression matrix; inspect the captured screenshots and console output.
3. Commit verified changes on `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` and report the commit SHA, results, remaining issues, and Samsung phone testing needs.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: clue-board behavior and save status handling.
- `js/core.js`: version 2 storage write implementation and success/failure return.
- `css/style.css`: clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `index.html`: clue-board and save-status markup.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; changes are uncommitted and not merged.
- The local game is open in Playwright at `http://localhost:3002`; opening reported one console error, not yet inspected.
- `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean. Save-failure behavior has been changed in `saveNow()` but still needs browser verification.
- Clue-card positions are clamped to the rendered card bounds; resizing can update positions and queue a save.
- Earlier screenshot review was limited to the 1280×800 title/intro; it showed no observed console errors other than missing `favicon.ico` (404).

## Objective
- Complete a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere,” preserving the existing game and reporting verified results before release.
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns, simplifications, and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run full story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.
- Continue from the saved workspace, preserve completed changes, and stop cleanly if the AI service fails again.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created QA branch `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Implemented save-failure reporting and timestamp preservation, save indicator styling, and clue-card bounds handling.
- Verified `git diff --check` and `node --check` for JavaScript files before the latest small save-label edit.
- Simulated save quota failure and recovery in prior browser validation: failed save returned false and retained prior timestamp; a subsequent successful save returned true and cleared failure state.
- Inspected current clue-board sizing and card fit/drag bounds logic; responsive CSS has desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.

### Active
- Verify the latest save-label fix: successful saves now set `savePip.textContent` to `Saved` while clearing failure styling; this edit is not yet browser-tested.
- Validate clue-card bounds, dragging, and resize behavior across desktop and mobile viewports.
- Run full story/endings, feature, screenshot, console, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots.
- Re-run final checks, commit verified changes on the QA branch, and report SHA/results/remaining issues/physical Samsung testing needs.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Verify the save-label recovery fix in the browser, then test clue-board layout, card bounds, dragging, and resizing across representative viewports.
2. Run feature and story/endings checks, capture and inspect screenshots, and record performance and console results.
3. Re-run syntax/diff checks, commit verified changes on `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` without merging, and report the commit SHA and outstanding phone-testing needs.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: save status handling and clue-board rendering/dragging.
- `js/core.js`: version 2 save storage; `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean.
- `css/style.css`: clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `index.html`: clue-board and save-status markup.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; `js/game.js` and `css/style.css` are modified and uncommitted.
- Local game URL is `http://localhost:3002`; Playwright is open in Chromium, currently in-game with intro dialogue active.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere.”
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.
- Preserve completed changes and stop cleanly if the AI service fails again.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created QA branch `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Implemented save-failure reporting and timestamp preservation, failure styling, and clue-card bounds handling in `js/game.js` and `css/style.css`.
- Refitted clue cards after board display and on resize; card bounds were verified inside the board at 320×568 and 1440×900.
- Verified quota failure reports `Save failed` and returns `false`; recovery reports `Saved`, returns `true`, and persists version 2 state.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check` for all `js/*.js` pass.
- Confirmed browser console currently reports one missing `http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico` 404 and no warnings.

### Active
- Validate clue-card dragging and board resizing across representative desktop/mobile viewports.
- Run remaining story/endings and feature checks; capture and inspect screenshots; measure performance and review console output.
- Re-run final checks, commit verified changes on the QA branch, and report results and physical Samsung phone testing needs.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue viewport, board drag/resize, feature, story/endings, screenshot, and performance regression testing.
2. Review remaining console output and note the favicon 404 if it persists.
3. Re-run checks and commit verified changes on `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` without merging.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Save status, clue-board fitting, resize, and drag behavior.
- `js/core.js`: Version 2 save storage; `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean.
- `css/style.css`: Clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `index.html`: Clue-board and save-status markup.
- `js/data.js`: Authored story, clue cards, deductions, and endings.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; `js/game.js` and `css/style.css` remain modified and uncommitted.
- Browser is at `http://localhost:3002/`; current saved state has the intro completed and watch card pinned.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere.”
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.
- Preserve completed changes and stop cleanly if the AI service fails again.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created QA branch `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Implemented save-failure reporting and timestamp preservation, failure styling, and clue-card bounds handling in `js/game.js` and `css/style.css`.
- Refitted clue cards after board display and on resize; card bounds were verified inside the board at 320×568 and 1440×900.
- Verified quota failure reports `Save failed` and returns `false`; recovery reports `Saved`, returns `true`, and persists version 2 state.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check` for all `js/*.js` pass.
- Confirmed browser console has one 404 for `http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico` and no warnings.

### Active
- Validate clue-card dragging and board resizing across representative desktop/mobile viewports.
- Run remaining story/endings and feature checks; capture and inspect screenshots; measure performance and review console output.
- Re-run final checks, commit verified changes on the QA branch, and report results and physical Samsung phone testing needs.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue viewport, board drag/resize, feature, story/endings, screenshot, and performance regression testing.
2. Review remaining console output and note the favicon 404 if it persists.
3. Re-run checks and commit verified changes on `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` without merging.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Save status, clue-board fitting, resize, and drag behavior.
- `js/core.js`: Version 2 save storage; `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean.
- `css/style.css`: Clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `index.html`: Clue-board and save-status markup.
- `js/data.js`: Authored story, clue cards, deductions, and endings.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; `js/game.js` and `css/style.css` remain modified and uncommitted.
- Browser is at `http://localhost:3002/`; saved state has the intro completed and watch card pinned.
- The clue board was open at 1440×900 in the latest browser check; the card was inside its canvas. At 320×568, the card fits after the board’s post-open animation-frame fit.
- No `package.json` or test files were found; regression checks so far have been manual/browser-based.
- Browser console currently reports only the missing favicon 404.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere.”
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.
- Preserve completed changes and stop cleanly if the AI service fails again.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created QA branch `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Implemented save-failure reporting and timestamp preservation, failure styling, and clue-card bounds handling in `js/game.js` and `css/style.css`.
- Refitted clue cards after board display and on resize; all 8 cards were verified within the board at 320×568, 375×667, 768×1024, 1440×900, and 844×390.
- Verified quota failure reports `Save failed` and returns `false`; recovery reports `Saved`, returns `true`, and persists version 2 state.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check` for all `js/*.js` pass.
- Browser console reports only the missing favicon 404 at `http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico`; no warnings.

### Active
- Validate clue-card dragging and board resizing behavior, including persisted positions.
- Run remaining story/endings and feature checks; capture and inspect screenshots; measure performance and review console output.
- Re-run final checks and commit verified changes on the QA branch without merging.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test card dragging and confirm positions persist through resize/reload.
2. Run story/endings and feature regression checks; capture and inspect screenshots and performance results.
3. Re-run checks, then commit verified changes on `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`; report results and physical Samsung phone testing needs.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Save status, clue-board fitting, resize, and drag behavior.
- `js/core.js`: Version 2 save storage; `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean.
- `css/style.css`: Clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `index.html`: Clue-board and save-status markup.
- `js/data.js`: Authored story, clue cards, deductions, and endings.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; `js/game.js` and `css/style.css` remain modified and uncommitted.
- Browser is at `http://localhost:3002/`; test state has all 8 clue cards enabled and the clue board open at 844×390. Restore or reset test state before final validation if needed.
- No `package.json` or test files were found; regression checks so far have been manual/browser-based.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere.”
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.
- Preserve completed changes and stop cleanly if the AI service fails again.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created QA branch `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Implemented save-failure reporting and timestamp preservation, failure styling, and clue-card bounds handling in `js/game.js` and `css/style.css`.
- Confirmed all 8 clue cards remain within the board at 320×568, 375×667, 768×1024, 1440×900, and 844×390 in earlier checks.
- Verified dragging a card updates saved `cardPos`, and the position survives resizing and reload; all cards remained within bounds at 320×568, 844×390, and 1440×900.
- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/clue-board-844x390.png`.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check` for all `js/*.js` pass.
- Earlier save test confirmed quota failure reports `Save failed` and returns `false`; recovery reports `Saved`, returns `true`, and persists version 2 state.

### Active
- Complete story/endings and feature regression checks, screenshots, and performance measurements.
- Investigate the failed endings test: the `returned` decision choice was present but not visible after calling `LT.game.openDecision()` on a test save fixture.
- Re-run final checks, commit verified changes on the QA branch, and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Diagnose the decision test fixture/readiness conditions and verify both endings through the intended story flow or a valid fixture.
2. Run remaining story and feature regression checks; capture/inspect relevant screenshots and measure performance.
3. Restore or reset browser test state, run final checks, and commit the verified changes on the QA branch without merging.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Save status, clue-board fitting, resize, drag behavior, and ending/decision flow.
- `js/core.js`: Version 2 save storage; `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean.
- `css/style.css`: Clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `js/data.js`: Authored story, clue cards, deductions, readiness conditions, and endings.
- `index.html`: Clue-board, decision, and save-status markup.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; `js/game.js` and `css/style.css` remain modified and uncommitted.
- Browser is at `http://localhost:3002/`; local storage/test state was modified for the unsuccessful endings test, so restore/reset before final validation.
- Browser console previously showed only the missing favicon 404 at `http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico`; no warnings.
- No `package.json` or test files were found; regression checks so far have been manual/browser-based.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere.”
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.
- Preserve completed changes and stop cleanly if the AI service fails again.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Implemented save-failure reporting and timestamp preservation, failure styling, and clue-card bounds handling in `js/game.js` and `css/style.css`.
- Confirmed both endings through separate browser pages using valid version 2 readiness fixtures: “The hour kept” (returned, 5 prose paragraphs) and “The quiet case” (kept, 6 paragraphs); both persisted correctly with `version: 2`.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check` for all `js/*.js` pass.
- Earlier save regression confirmed quota failure reports `Save failed` and returns `false`; recovery reports `Saved`, returns `true`, and persists version 2 state.
- Captured clue-board screenshots at 320×568, 375×667, 768×1024, 1440×900, and 844×390; visually inspected 320×568, 375×667, 1440×900, and 844×390.

### Active
- Fix and re-verify the clue-board bounds defect found at 844×390: cards are clipped vertically after resizing, despite earlier checks passing.
- Complete remaining story and feature regression checks, screenshot inspection, and performance measurements.
- Restore/reset browser test state, run final checks, and commit verified changes on the QA branch without merging.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Investigate why `fitBoardCards()` leaves cards clipped at 844×390 after viewport resize; retest all five viewport sizes, including reload and drag persistence.
2. Finish story, save-failure/recovery, feature, screenshot, and performance checks; reset browser state afterward.
3. Run final syntax and diff checks, commit verified changes on `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, and report results plus physical Samsung phone testing needs.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Save status, clue-board fitting, resize, drag behavior, and ending/decision flow.
- `css/style.css`: Clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `js/core.js`: Version 2 save storage; `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean.
- `js/data.js`: Authored story, clue cards, deductions, readiness conditions, and endings.
- `index.html`: Clue-board, decision, and save-status markup.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; `js/game.js` and `css/style.css` remain modified and uncommitted.
- Latest viewport test: all cards fit at 320×568, 375×667, 768×1024, and 1440×900; at 844×390 the measured board is 540.7×246.3 and cards extend about 5 px above and below it.
- Screenshots are in `/tmp/opencode/clue-board-{320x568,375x667,768x1024,1440x900,844x390}.png`; the landscape clipping is visible in the 844×390 capture.
- Browser storage contains test fixture state and needs restoration/reset before final validation.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and verify a release-quality pass for “The Little Things — an evening in Harrowmere.”
- Commit targeted fixes and test results on a separate QA branch; do not merge into `main`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing story, dialogue, characters, atmosphere, artwork, environments, puzzle logic, and two endings; avoid redesigns and unnecessary dependencies.
- Fix responsive clue-board layout and truthful save-failure handling without changing the version 2 save format.
- Run story, feature, viewport, screenshot, and performance regression tests; inspect screenshots and report physical Samsung phone testing needs.
- Preserve completed changes and stop cleanly if the AI service fails again.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing game and make only targeted release-quality fixes.
- Base the QA branch on `origin/opencode-deployments/9` (`895b480`, issue #9 deployment).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10` from `origin/opencode-deployments/9`.
- Implemented save-failure reporting and timestamp preservation, failure styling, and clue-card bounds handling in `js/game.js` and `css/style.css`.
- Confirmed both endings with valid version 2 readiness fixtures: “The hour kept” (returned, 5 prose paragraphs) and “The quiet case” (kept, 6 paragraphs); both persisted correctly with `version: 2`.
- Verified save failure returns `false`, preserves the previous timestamp, and displays `Save failed`; recovery returns `true`, displays `Saved`, and persists version 2 state.
- Tested clue-card dragging, save persistence, and reload restoration with `version: 2`.
- Retested all five viewports—320×568, 375×667, 768×1024, 1440×900, and 844×390—and confirmed all eight cards stay inside the board at each size.
- Captured screenshots for all five sizes in `/tmp/opencode/clue-board-{320x568,375x667,768x1024,1440x900,844x390}.png`; screenshot inspection remains to be completed.
- Restored browser localStorage after the latest viewport and drag test.

### Active
- Complete remaining story and feature regression checks, screenshot inspection, and performance measurements.
- Run final syntax and diff checks, commit verified changes on the QA branch without merging, and report results plus physical Samsung phone testing needs.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish story, save-failure/recovery, feature, screenshot, and performance regression checks.
2. Run final syntax and diff checks, commit verified changes on `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, and do not merge.
3. Report test results and outstanding physical Samsung phone testing needs.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Save status, clue-board fitting, resize, drag behavior, and ending/decision flow.
- `css/style.css`: Clue-board responsive layout and save-indicator styling.
- `js/core.js`: Version 2 save storage; `SAVE.write(S)` returns a boolean.
- `js/data.js`: Authored story, clue cards, deductions, readiness conditions, and endings.
- `index.html`: Clue-board, decision, and save-status markup.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `qa/release-quality-2026-11-10`, based on `895b480`; `js/game.js` and `css/style.css` are modified and uncommitted.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check` for all `js/*.js` passed earlier; rerun before committing.
- Browser tests used `http://localhost:3002/`; latest test restored localStorage after use.
- The latest viewport test confirmed all eight cards fit within measured board bounds at all five sizes; at 844×390 the board is 541×246.
